title: Hybrid Power Split Device. eCVT transmission.
summary: A short animated explanation of the power split device in Toyota-style hybrids, a planetary gearset that works as an eCVT. It shows how engine and motor power are combined.
why: HN people link it in hybrid versus EV debates as a clear view of how simple the hybrid drivetrain really is.

quote.text: Another one from WeberAuto like in my parent comment, this time on the (apparently very similar) Honda system
